productName: French Country 3 Drawer Dresser with Door
description:
Maximize your nursery storage with the French Country 3 Drawer Dresser with Door. This versatile piece offers the best of both worlds: three smooth-gliding drawers for everyday essentials and a spacious cabinet with door for larger items or items you prefer to keep out of sight.

The three dovetailed drawers are perfect for clothing, diapers, and accessories, while the enclosed cabinet provides room for blankets, towels, stuffed animals, or diaper stockpiles. The solid wood construction and French Country detailing, including turned legs and decorative hardware, make this dresser a standout piece in any nursery. The flat top accommodates a changing pad, creating a convenient diaper station.
